stem.text: A football falls from the top of a tall building.
Which graph best represents the way in which the distance $x$ fallen varies with time $t$?

A.alt: Graph with x on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0, with one curve drawn.

B.alt: Graph with x on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0, with one line drawn.

C.alt: Graph with x on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0, with one curve drawn.

D.alt: Graph with x on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0, with one curve drawn.
